name: ASM · Orchestrator
description: External attack surface pipeline. Every 6h / manual / form: scope gate from asm_scope, per-engagement lock, then Discovery, Takeover, Ports, Web, Diff, Vuln, Findings sub-workflows. Tracks runs in asm_runs.

parameters.formDescription: Runs the full pipeline for one engagement already defined (and enabled) in asm_scope. Ad-hoc targets are not accepted here.

values.formSubmittedText: Run started. Progress lands in #n8n-alerts and the asm_runs table.

parameters.command:
=E='{{ $('Run Context').first().json.engagement }}'
case "$E" in ''|*[!a-z0-9_-]*) echo 'bad engagement' >&2; exit 1;; esac
rmdir "/opt/loot/asm/$E/.lock" 2>/dev/null || true
echo '{"released":true}'

parameters.content:
## ASM pipeline
Scope lives in the **asm_scope** data table (only `enabled = true` rows run). Types: domain, wildcard, host, ip, cidr (/16 or narrower), url. `exclude = true` rows remove names, IPs or ranges. Intrusive checks (nuclei DAST, dalfox, intrusive templates) need `allow_intrusive = true` on every asset row of the engagement. Optional `window_start_utc` / `window_end_utc` (HH:MM). Evidence: /opt/loot/asm/<engagement>/<run_id>/. State for diffing: /opt/loot/asm/<engagement>/state/.

nodeGroups.name: Close out run
nodeGroups.description: Writes asm_runs, posts a summary when something changed (or the run failed / was manual), releases the engagement lock.

nodeGroups.name: Per-engagement lock
nodeGroups.description: Writes scope files and takes /opt/loot/asm/<eng>/.lock; a run already in progress skips this engagement (stale after 16h).

nodeGroups.name: Intake and scope gate
nodeGroups.description: Load asm_scope, drop engagements outside scope_start/scope_end, validate targets, build scope bundle.
